tEn: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (almost) Everything
tZh: Qwen-CUA：原生计算机使用，几乎适用于一切
sEn: Qwen-CUA, a native computer-use agent with a 397B-A17B MoE backbone, achieves state-of-the-art results on eight benchmarks by learning from screenshots and keyboard/mouse actions, outperforming Qwen3.7 and rivaling proprietary systems.
sZh: Qwen-CUA通过仅观察截图和模拟键盘鼠标操作，在八个基准测试中超越Qwen3.7并媲美专有系统，展示了原生计算机使用作为通用智能体基础的潜力。
absEn: Native computer use offers a general interface for agents to operate almost any software available to people, but requires long-horizon state tracking, large-scale interactive experience, and learning from sparse yet verifiable outcomes. We introduce Qwen-CUA, a native computer-use agent with a 397B-A17B Qwen mixture-of-experts backbone. It observes only screenshots and acts through keyboard and mouse events, without DOM trees, accessibility metadata, or task-specific APIs. Its scaffold maintains up to 20 active screenshots and folds older visual history in fixed-size blocks to retain recent evidence while preserving reusable prompt prefixes. For training, we build a cloud rollout fleet with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and tens of thousands of concurrent environments, construct approximately 40,000 verifiable tasks, and collect personalized long-horizon workflows across everyday and professional software. We optimize complete trajectories with verifiable rewards and trajectory slicing, while iterative training runs refresh supervised data and recalibrate reinforcement-learning tasks. Across eight benchmarks, Qwen-CUA outperforms Qwen3.7 and remains competitive with leading proprietary systems, reaching 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified and 18.5/48.4 binary/partial completion on OSWorld 2.0. Scaling the same recipe to a model with over one trillion parameters yields Qwen-CUA-Max, improving these scores to 87.6 and 21.2/53.3. Qwen-CUA also reduces RedTeamCUA attack success from 36.6 to 16.4 relative to Qwen3.7. Efficiency analyses, a browser deployment, and Bash-augmented experiments further characterize practical behavior. These results establish native computer use as a broadly capable agent foundation and highlight scalable verifiable interaction and hybrid tool use as key directions.
absZh: 原生计算机使用为智能体提供了一个通用接口，使其能够操作人们可用的几乎任何软件，但这需要长时间跨度的状态跟踪、大规模交互式体验以及从稀疏但可验证的结果中学习。我们推出了Qwen-CUA，一个原生计算机使用智能体，基于397B-A17B参数的Qwen混合专家模型。它仅通过截图观察，并通过键盘和鼠标事件进行操作，不依赖DOM树、可访问性元数据或特定任务的API。其脚手架维护最多20个活动截图，并将较旧的视觉历史折叠成固定大小的块，以保留近期证据并复用提示前缀。在训练方面，我们构建了一个云部署舰队，可访问近10万个vCPU和数万个并发环境，构建了约4万个可验证任务，并收集了涵盖日常和专业软件的个性化长时程工作流。我们通过可验证奖励和轨迹切片优化完整轨迹，同时迭代训练运行刷新监督数据并重新校准强化学习任务。在八个基准测试中，Qwen-CUA超越了Qwen3.7，并与领先的专有系统保持竞争力，在OSWorld-Verified上达到86.2，在OSWorld 2.0上达到18.5/48.4的二元/部分完成率。将相同配方扩展到超过一万亿参数的模型，得到Qwen-CUA-Max，将这些分数提升至87.6和21.2/53.3。Qwen-CUA还将RedTeamCUA攻击成功率从36.6降至16.4（相对于Qwen3.7）。效率分析、浏览器部署和Bash增强实验进一步刻画了实际行为。这些结果确立了原生计算机使用作为广泛能力的智能体基础，并突出了可验证交互和混合工具使用作为关键方向。

full.sec: Qwen-CUA: Native Computer Use for (almost) Everything
full.secZh: Qwen-CUA：面向（几乎）一切任务的原生计算机使用

items.en: Native computer use offers a general route to agents that can operate almost any software through the same interface available to people. Realizing this promise, however, requires more than visual grounding: an agent must sustain long-horizon state, acquire large amounts of costly interactive experience, and learn from outcomes that are sparse but reliably verifiable. We introduce Qwen-CUA, a native computer-use agent with a 397B-A17B Qwen mixture-of-experts backbone. It observes only screenshots and acts through keyboard and mouse events, without DOM trees, accessibility metadata, or task-specific APIs. Its agent scaffold expands the active visual history to 20 screenshots and folds older screenshots in fixed-size blocks, retaining recent visual evidence while preserving reusable prompt prefixes. To scale training, we build a cloud rollout fleet with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and tens of thousands of concurrent environments, construct approximately 40,000 verifiable tasks, and collect personalized long-horizon workflows in everyday and professional software. We optimize complete trajectories with verifiable rewards and long-horizon trajectory slicing, and develop the model through iterative training runs that use each resulting policy to refresh the supervised data mixture and calibrate the reinforcement-learning task distribution. Across eight computer-use benchmarks, Qwen-CUA consistently outperforms Qwen3.7 and remains competitive with leading proprietary systems, reaching 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified and 18.5 / 48.4 binary / partial completion on OSWorld 2.0. Scaling the same recipe to a model with over one trillion total parameters yields Qwen-CUA-Max, which further improves these scores to 87.6 and 21.2 / 53.3. Qwen-CUA also reduces attack success on RedTeamCUA from 36.6 to 16.4 relative to Qwen3.7. Efficiency analyses, an internal browser deployment, and experiments combining native interaction with Bash further characterize its practical behavior. These results show that native computer use can serve as a broadly capable foundation, while scalable verifiable interaction and hybrid tool use are key to making it effective in practice.
items.zh: 原生计算机使用为智能体提供了一条通用路径，使其能够通过与人相同的界面操作几乎任何软件。然而，要实现这一愿景，仅靠视觉基础是不够的：智能体必须维持长时程状态、获取大量昂贵的交互经验，并从稀疏但可可靠验证的结果中学习。我们推出了 Qwen-CUA，一个原生计算机使用智能体，其骨干网络为 397B-A17B 的 Qwen 混合专家模型。它仅通过截图观察，并通过键盘和鼠标事件进行操作，不依赖 DOM 树、可访问性元数据或特定任务的 API。其智能体脚手架将活动视觉历史扩展到 20 张截图，并将较旧的截图折叠成固定大小的块，既保留了最近的视觉证据，又保留了可复用的提示前缀。为了扩展训练规模，我们构建了一个云端的 rollout 集群，可访问近 10 万个 vCPU 和数万个并发环境，构建了约 4 万个可验证任务，并在日常和专业软件中收集个性化的长时程工作流。我们使用可验证奖励和长时程轨迹切片来优化完整轨迹，并通过迭代训练运行来开发模型，每次运行都利用所得策略来刷新监督数据混合并校准强化学习任务分布。在八个计算机使用基准测试中，Qwen-CUA 持续优于 Qwen3.7，并与领先的专有系统保持竞争力，在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 86.2，在 OSWorld 2.0 上达到 18.5 / 48.4 的二元/部分完成率。将相同的配方扩展到总参数超过一万亿的模型，得到 Qwen-CUA-Max，其进一步将这些分数提升至 87.6 和 21.2 / 53.3。Qwen-CUA 还将 RedTeamCUA 上的攻击成功率从 36.6 降至 16.4（相对于 Qwen3.7）。效率分析、内部浏览器部署以及将原生交互与 Bash 相结合的实验进一步刻画了其实际行为。这些结果表明，原生计算机使用可以作为一个广泛能力的基础，而可扩展的可验证交互和混合工具使用是使其在实践中有效的关键。

items.en: Agents act on the digital world through three broad interfaces: code, APIs, and graphical interfaces designed for people. Foundation models have become highly capable at the first two, writing programs and composing software tools. Yet much digital work lies beyond them: desktop applications, legacy systems, dynamic websites, professional tools, and personalized workflows often expose functionality only visually. Native computer use closes this gap. By perceiving pixels and producing keyboard-and-mouse events, an agent can operate the same software as a person without dedicated integrations, unlocking workflows previously accessible mainly through direct human interaction.
items.zh: 智能体通过三种广泛的接口作用于数字世界：代码、API 以及为人类设计的图形界面。基础模型在前两种接口上已经变得非常强大，能够编写程序和组合软件工具。然而，许多数字工作超出了这些接口的范围：桌面应用程序、遗留系统、动态网站、专业工具和个性化工作流通常仅通过视觉方式暴露功能。原生计算机使用弥补了这一差距。通过感知像素并产生键盘和鼠标事件，智能体可以像人一样操作相同的软件，而无需专门的集成，从而解锁了以前主要通过直接人机交互才能访问的工作流。

items.en: This human-facing interface poses distinct learning challenges. GUI state is partially observed and machine-unreadable; actions require pixel grounding, errors compound over long workflows, and evidence spans screenshot history. Benchmarks now cover open-ended web and operating-system tasks, but each rollout consumes a stateful environment and real interaction time, while reliable supervision often arrives only from the final state. Agents must also generalize to personalized desktops, professional software, simulated users, and adversarial on-screen content. Progress therefore requires scaling environments, verifiable tasks, rollout throughput, and learning from long multimodal trajectories.
items.zh: 这种面向人类的接口带来了独特的学习挑战。GUI 状态是部分可观察且机器不可读的；动作需要像素级定位，错误在长工作流中会累积，证据跨越截图历史。基准测试现在涵盖了开放式的网页和操作系统任务，但每次 rollout 都会消耗有状态的环境和真实的交互时间，而可靠的监督通常仅来自最终状态。智能体还必须泛化到个性化桌面、专业软件、模拟用户和对抗性屏幕内容。因此，进展需要扩展环境、可验证任务、rollout 吞吐量，并从长多模态轨迹中学习。

items.en: We present Qwen-CUA, a Qwen model trained end to end for native computer use. It receives only screenshots and emits keyboard-and-mouse actions, without DOM trees, accessibility metadata, shell access, or task-specific APIs. This minimal interface transfers unchanged across browsers and desktop applications. For long-horizon operation, Qwen-CUA retains 20 active screenshots and folds older screenshots in blocks of ten, bounding visual context while keeping the prompt prefix stable for improved KV-cache reuse.
items.zh: 我们提出了 Qwen-CUA，一个为原生计算机使用而端到端训练的 Qwen 模型。它仅接收截图并输出键盘和鼠标动作，无需 DOM 树、可访问性元数据、shell 访问或特定任务的 API。这种最小接口在浏览器和桌面应用程序之间不变地迁移。对于长时程操作，Qwen-CUA 保留 20 个活动截图，并将较旧的截图按十个一组折叠，从而限制视觉上下文，同时保持提示前缀稳定以改进 KV 缓存重用。

items.en: To produce verifiable interaction at scale, we build an Alibaba Cloud ECS rollout fleet with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and tens of thousands of concurrent environments. The environment pool combines controllable mock web services with everyday, long-tail, and professional desktop applications. We construct approximately 40,000 verifiable tasks spanning environment operation, simulated-user interaction, and long-horizon workflows constructed through verifiable phase-state chaining. Human trajectories from personalized desktops and specialized software provide complementary supervision, augmented with action-grounded step-level reasoning.
items.zh: 为了大规模产生可验证的交互，我们构建了一个阿里云 ECS rollout 集群，可访问近 100,000 个 vCPU 和数万个并发环境。环境池结合了可控的模拟 Web 服务与日常、长尾和专业桌面应用程序。我们构建了约 40,000 个可验证任务，涵盖环境操作、模拟用户交互以及通过可验证的阶段状态链构建的长时程工作流。来自个性化桌面和专业软件的人类轨迹提供了补充监督，并辅以动作基础的步骤级推理。

items.en: Qwen-CUA is optimized with executable outcome rewards, building on the scalable environment and task design of CUA-Gym. Soft Adaptive Policy Optimization (SAPO) stabilizes updates over long reasoning-and-action sequences, while trajectory slicing preserves episode-level rewards across image-heavy histories. Training proceeds in iterations: each resulting model reveals unresolved SFT queries and weak domains, guiding teacher rerolls, new human trajectories, targeted data collection, and RL task calibration for the next run.
items.zh: Qwen-CUA 通过可执行的结果奖励进行优化，建立在 CUA-Gym 的可扩展环境和任务设计之上。软自适应策略优化（SAPO）稳定了长推理和动作序列上的更新，而轨迹切片在图像密集的历史中保留了回合级奖励。训练迭代进行：每个生成的模型都会揭示未解决的 SFT 查询和薄弱领域，指导教师重掷、新的人类轨迹、有针对性的数据收集以及下一轮 RL 任务校准。

items.en: Under a native keyboard-and-mouse computer-use protocol, Qwen-CUA outperforms Qwen3.7 on the task metric of all eight benchmarks. It reaches 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified, compared with 73.3 for Qwen3.7, 78.7 for GPT-5.5, and 83.4 for Claude Opus 4.8, and improves OSWorld 2.0 binary / partial completion from 2.5 / 22.5 to 18.5 / 48.4. Scaling the 397B-A17B model to over one trillion total parameters yields Qwen-CUA-Max, further increasing these results to 87.6 and 21.2 / 53.3. Qwen-CUA also reduces RedTeamCUA attack success from 36.6 to 16.4 relative to Qwen3.7 while improving task success.
items.zh: 在原生键盘鼠标计算机使用协议下，Qwen-CUA 在全部八个基准测试的任务指标上均优于 Qwen3.7。它在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 86.2，而 Qwen3.7 为 73.3，GPT-5.5 为 78.7，Claude Opus 4.8 为 83.4；并将 OSWorld 2.0 的二元/部分完成率从 2.5/22.5 提升至 18.5/48.4。将 397B-A17B 模型扩展至超过一万亿总参数，得到 Qwen-CUA-Max，进一步将上述结果提升至 87.6 和 21.2/53.3。与 Qwen3.7 相比，Qwen-CUA 还将 RedTeamCUA 的攻击成功率从 36.6 降至 16.4，同时提高了任务成功率。

items.en: Efficiency sweeps show that these gains are not explained simply by more verbose reasoning. An internal Chrome deployment demonstrates naturally occurring browser workflows with user confirmation for consequential actions, while MyPCBench experiments show that combining native interaction with Bash can substantially shorten trajectories. Together, these studies motivate native computer use as a general visual foundation that can be combined with specialized tools for efficient execution.
items.zh: 效率扫描表明，这些收益并非仅仅由更冗长的推理所解释。内部 Chrome 部署展示了自然发生的浏览器工作流，并对重要操作进行用户确认；而 MyPCBench 实验表明，将原生交互与 Bash 结合可以大幅缩短轨迹。这些研究共同表明，原生计算机使用可作为通用的视觉基础，可与专用工具结合以实现高效执行。

items.en: Our main contributions are:
items.zh: 我们的主要贡献如下：

items.en: A screenshot-only Qwen-CUA model with native keyboard-and-mouse control and efficient long-horizon visual context management, which outperforms Qwen3.7 on all eight computer-use benchmarks and reaches 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified.
items.zh: 一个仅基于截图的 Qwen-CUA 模型，具备原生键盘鼠标控制和高效的长时程视觉上下文管理，在全部八个计算机使用基准测试上优于 Qwen3.7，并在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 86.2。

items.en: Scaled verifiable experience from nearly 100,000 vCPUs, 40,000 verifiable tasks, diverse controllable environments, and personalized expert workflows.
items.zh: 从近 100,000 个 vCPU、40,000 个可验证任务、多样化的可控环境以及个性化专家工作流中获得的规模化可验证经验。

items.en: A comprehensive evaluation of Qwen-CUA across eight benchmarks, plus analyses showing that its gains are not explained by more verbose reasoning, that RedTeamCUA attack success drops from 36.6 to 16.4, and that pairing native interaction with Bash shortens trajectories; scaling the same recipe to the trillion-parameter Qwen-CUA-Max further lifts OSWorld-Verified and OSWorld 2.0 to 87.6 and 21.2 / 53.3.
items.zh: 对Qwen-CUA在八个基准上的全面评估，以及分析表明其增益并非由更冗长的推理所解释，RedTeamCUA攻击成功率从36.6降至16.4，且将原生交互与Bash配对可缩短轨迹；将相同配方扩展到万亿参数的Qwen-CUA-Max，进一步将OSWorld-Verified和OSWorld 2.0提升至87.6和21.2 / 53.3。

items.en: Following recent screenshot-based computer-use agent systems, Qwen-CUA combines a minimal native computer-use interface with expanded visual-history capacity and lightweight context management for long-horizon interaction.
items.zh: 继最近的基于截图的计算机使用智能体系统之后，Qwen-CUA 将极简的原生计算机使用界面与扩展的视觉历史容量和轻量级上下文管理相结合，以支持长时程交互。

items.en: Qwen-CUA is implemented around a native computer-use interface. At each step, the agent observes only a screenshot of the current desktop state and emits an action from a keyboard-and-mouse action space. This interface deliberately avoids task-specific APIs, accessibility trees, DOM access, or application-level shortcuts that would expose hidden state beyond the pixels on screen. Instead, the model controls the computer through native input events. This design makes the agent interface close to how a human uses a desktop computer: perception is visual, and execution is grounded in keyboard and mouse operations (Figure 2.1). The full action schema is listed in Appendix A.
items.zh: Qwen-CUA 围绕一个原生计算机使用界面实现。在每一步中，智能体仅观察当前桌面状态的截图，并从键盘和鼠标动作空间中发出一个动作。该界面刻意避免了任务特定的 API、可访问性树、DOM 访问或应用程序级快捷方式，这些都会暴露屏幕像素之外的隐藏状态。相反，模型通过原生输入事件控制计算机。这种设计使智能体界面接近人类使用桌面计算机的方式：感知是视觉的，执行基于键盘和鼠标操作（图 2.1）。完整的动作模式列于附录 A。

items.en: Long-horizon computer use produces image-heavy histories whose visual cost grows with every interaction. Keeping all screenshots eventually exceeds the practical context budget, while a conventional sliding window may discard the earlier state that explains subsequent reasoning and actions.
items.zh: 长程计算机使用会产生图像密集的历史记录，其视觉成本随每次交互而增长。保留所有截图最终会超出实际上下文预算，而传统的滑动窗口可能会丢弃解释后续推理和行动的早期状态。

items.en: Scaling visual history. Screenshot-only interaction requires the model to retain earlier interface states as a task progresses. Qwen-CUA scales the active visual history to 20 screenshots per turn, continuing the increase in visual-context capacity across successive Qwen generations. The larger history helps the agent track progress and revisit earlier visual evidence during extended workflows (Figure 2.2(a)).
items.zh: 扩展视觉历史。仅截图的交互要求模型在任务进行中保留早期的界面状态。Qwen-CUA 将每轮活动的视觉历史扩展到 20 张截图，延续了 Qwen 系列中视觉上下文容量的持续增长。更大的历史记录帮助智能体在扩展工作流中跟踪进度并重新审视早期的视觉证据（图 2.2(a)）。

items.en: Chunked screenshot folding. Qwen-CUA maintains a folded-prefix boundary over the interaction history and allows at most 20 active screenshots. Whenever the active visual history exceeds this budget, the boundary advances by 10 steps at once. Screenshots behind the boundary are replaced with a fixed textual placeholder, while the corresponding reasoning and actions remain in the conversation; recent screenshots are retained in their original visual form. The procedure is deterministic and requires no additional summarization model.
items.zh: 分块截图折叠。Qwen-CUA 在交互历史上维护一个折叠前缀边界，并允许最多 20 张活动截图。每当活动视觉历史超过此预算时，边界一次前进 10 步。边界之后的截图被替换为固定的文本占位符，而相应的推理和操作保留在对话中；最近的截图保留其原始视觉形式。该过程是确定性的，不需要额外的摘要模型。

items.en: Training-time trajectory slicing. Reinforcement learning uses the same fold operator. Complete episodes are rendered as multiple context-bounded slices by advancing the folded-prefix boundary; each slice inherits the terminal reward, and only active model-generated tokens contribute to its loss. This preserves supervision for late-stage decisions while aligning training and inference without separately generated summaries.
items.zh: 训练时轨迹切片。强化学习使用相同的折叠操作。通过推进折叠前缀边界，完整的回合被渲染为多个上下文受限的切片；每个切片继承终止奖励，并且只有活动的模型生成的 token 对其损失有贡献。这保留了对后期决策的监督，同时使训练和推理对齐，无需单独生成的摘要。

items.en: Benefits. This design bounds visual-token growth while preserving recent pixels and older actions. Because the boundary advances only every 10 steps, steps 21–30 extend the same request prefix rather than rewriting it on every call, improving KV-cache reuse. This follows the cache-aware batched-pruning principle described in Anthropic’s computer-use guidance. Figure 2.2(b) adapts the slicing view of CUA-Gym; Appendix B gives the exact procedure.
items.zh: 优势。这种设计限制了视觉 token 的增长，同时保留了最近的像素和较早的操作。由于边界每 10 步才前进一次，步骤 21–30 扩展了相同的请求前缀，而不是在每次调用时重写它，从而提高了 KV 缓存重用。这遵循了 Anthropic 计算机使用指南中描述的缓存感知批量剪枝原则。图 2.2(b) 改编自 CUA-Gym 的切片视图；附录 B 给出了确切的过程。

items.en: Scaling computer-use agents requires more than increasing model capacity: it also requires scaling the interactive environments, task diversity, outcome supervision, and experience collection that support agentic learning. Qwen-CUA therefore spans rollout infrastructure, computer-use data, verifiable reinforcement learning, and iterative agent training. Large-scale cloud infrastructure turns task execution into a continuous source of trajectories across diverse software environments, while executable evaluators convert environment transitions into reliable outcome feedback. Within each iteration, the resulting model is used to identify unresolved queries and weak domains. These diagnostics refresh both the supervised data mixture and the RL task distribution before the next model is trained. Figure 4 summarizes the scaling of training resources and the corresponding performance across successive development checkpoints.
items.zh: 扩展计算机使用智能体不仅需要增加模型容量，还需要扩展支持智能体式学习的交互环境、任务多样性、结果监督和经验收集。因此，Qwen-CUA 涵盖了 rollout 基础设施、计算机使用数据、可验证的强化学习和迭代式智能体训练。大规模云基础设施将任务执行转化为跨多样软件环境的连续轨迹来源，而可执行评估器将环境转换转化为可靠的结果反馈。在每次迭代中，生成的模型用于识别未解决的查询和薄弱领域。这些诊断在训练下一个模型之前，会刷新监督数据混合和强化学习任务分布。图 4 总结了训练资源的扩展以及连续开发检查点上的相应性能。

items.capEn: Figure 4: Scaling and iterating computer-use training. (a) Performance grows with model, task, and infrastructure scale. (b) Evaluation scores at successive development checkpoints, with SFT data and RL tasks refreshed between runs.

full.secZh: 3.1 可扩展的计算机使用基础设施

items.en: Large-scale computer-use training requires a substantial pool of isolated and stateful desktop environments. We build our rollout infrastructure on Alibaba Cloud Elastic Compute Service (ECS), with access to nearly 100,000 vCPUs and the capacity to support tens of thousands of concurrent computer-use environments. The infrastructure parallelizes environment provisioning and reset, task dispatch, agent–environment interaction, outcome verification, and trajectory logging. This provides the interaction throughput required for large-scale experience collection and reinforcement learning, allowing fresh trajectories to be continuously generated across diverse software environments. Related systems such as NanoRollout decouple agent harnesses, environment runtimes, and training backends behind a shared rollout service, highlighting the importance of scaling environment-side execution independently of model training.
items.zh: 大规模计算机使用训练需要大量隔离且有状态的桌面环境。我们将回滚基础设施构建在阿里云弹性计算服务（ECS）上，可访问近10万个vCPU，并支持数万个并发计算机使用环境。该基础设施并行化了环境配置与重置、任务调度、智能体与环境交互、结果验证以及轨迹记录。这为大规模经验收集和强化学习提供了所需的交互吞吐量，使得能够在多样化的软件环境中持续生成新的轨迹。类似NanoRollout的相关系统将智能体框架、环境运行时和训练后端解耦，置于共享的回滚服务之后，凸显了独立于模型训练来扩展环境端执行的重要性。

items.en: Scaling computer-use training requires more than collecting additional trajectories. Each training instance must be grounded in an executable environment, paired with a task whose outcome can be reliably verified, and complemented by high-quality demonstrations for behaviors that are difficult to discover through rollout alone. We therefore scale Qwen-CUA's training data along three complementary dimensions: diverse and controllable software environments, state-grounded verifiable tasks, and personalized long-horizon trajectories.
items.zh: Scaling（规模扩张）计算机使用训练不仅仅需要收集更多的轨迹。每个训练实例必须基于可执行的环境，与结果可可靠验证的任务配对，并辅以高质量演示，以覆盖仅通过 rollout 难以发现的行为。因此，我们沿着三个互补的维度扩展 Qwen-CUA 的训练数据：多样且可控的软件环境、基于状态的可靠验证任务，以及个性化的长时程轨迹。

items.en: The diversity of computer-use experience is ultimately bounded by the breadth of the underlying environments. To expand controllable web coverage, we follow recent work on verifiable environment synthesis and develop self-contained mock web services that preserve the interaction flows of widely used products while exposing programmatic control over their state. A unified interface supports task-specific state injection, inspection, reset, and session isolation, allowing one application to instantiate many reproducible tasks and serve concurrent rollouts without cross-episode interference.
items.zh: 计算机使用体验的多样性最终受限于底层环境的广度。为了扩大可控的网页覆盖范围，我们遵循近期在可验证环境合成方面的工作，开发了自包含的模拟网页服务，这些服务保留了广泛使用产品的交互流程，同时暴露对其状态的可编程控制。统一接口支持任务特定的状态注入、检查、重置和会话隔离，使得一个应用能够实例化许多可复现的任务，并支持并发回滚，而不会产生跨回合干扰。

items.en: We also broaden the environment pool beyond common office applications to creative, scientific, engineering, and other professional software, including specialized and long-tail desktop applications. Following the environment scaling direction explored by Gym-Anything, each application is installed and configured in a sandboxed desktop environment, then populated with realistic files, artifacts, and application-specific state. Together, controllable web mocks and broad desktop coverage balance scalable state verification with interaction fidelity, enabling experience collection across both everyday and specialized workflows.
items.zh: 我们还将环境池扩展到常见办公应用之外，涵盖创意、科学、工程和其他专业软件，包括专业化和长尾桌面应用。遵循Gym-Anything探索的环境扩展方向，每个应用都在沙盒桌面环境中安装和配置，然后填充真实的文件、工件和应用特定状态。可控的网页模拟和广泛的桌面覆盖共同平衡了可扩展的状态验证与交互保真度，使得能够在日常和专业工作流程中收集经验。

items.en: The first class teaches the agent to understand and operate a particular environment. Building on recent verifiable task-synthesis systems, we sample tasks from application-specific feature taxonomies and common usage scenarios, covering the interface elements, operations, and state transitions of each environment. Every task couples a natural-language goal with a reproducible initial state and an executable evaluator, and is audited against reference outcomes and agent rollouts to remove ambiguous, infeasible, or weakly verified instances.
items.zh: 第一类任务教会智能体理解和操作特定环境。基于近期可验证任务合成系统，我们从应用特定的特征分类法和常见使用场景中采样任务，覆盖每个环境的界面元素、操作和状态转换。每个任务将自然语言目标与可复现的初始状态和可执行评估器相结合，并对照参考结果和智能体轨迹进行审计，以剔除模糊、不可行或验证不充分的实例。

items.en: The second class requires interaction with the user during execution. Many realistic requests omit necessary information or contain constraints that cannot be resolved from the environment alone. Following the simulated-user setting of OSWorld 2.0, we construct tasks in which a user simulator holds bounded, task-specific knowledge and responds only when the agent asks for clarification. These tasks train the model to recognize missing evidence, ask targeted questions, and incorporate the response rather than proceeding with unsupported assumptions. Completion remains grounded in the resulting environment state, so asking the user is useful only when it leads to a correct outcome.
items.zh: 第二类任务要求在执行过程中与用户交互。许多现实请求缺少必要信息或包含无法仅从环境解决的约束。遵循 OSWorld 2.0 的模拟用户设置，我们构建了这样的任务：用户模拟器持有有限的任务特定知识，并且仅在智能体请求澄清时响应。这些任务训练模型识别缺失证据、提出针对性问题并整合响应，而不是基于无根据的假设继续执行。完成度仍以最终环境状态为依据，因此只有在能带来正确结果时，询问用户才有用。

items.en: The third class targets complex workflows that require the agent to repeatedly move among applications, files, and services while maintaining a coherent task state. We construct rich initial states spanning messages, prior records, and application-specific artifacts, then organize each workflow into interdependent phases rather than concatenating unrelated subtasks. Each phase has a verifiable completion state; once validated, that state can be serialized and used to initialize the next phase. This phase-state chaining makes complex workflows easier to generate and audit incrementally while retaining the fully chained workflow for end-to-end rollout and long-horizon training.
items.zh: 第三类任务针对复杂工作流，要求智能体在应用、文件和服务之间反复切换，同时保持连贯的任务状态。我们构建涵盖消息、历史记录和应用特定工件的丰富初始状态，然后将每个工作流组织为相互依赖的阶段，而不是拼接不相关的子任务。每个阶段都有可验证的完成状态；一旦验证通过，该状态可序列化并用于初始化下一阶段。这种阶段状态链使得复杂工作流更易于增量生成和审计，同时保留完整链式工作流以进行端到端展开和长视野训练。

items.en: Verifiable tasks provide scalable outcome feedback, but many real workflows are grounded in a user’s own files, history, preferences, and application state. We therefore build on large-scale human computer-use demonstration collection, such as OpenCUA, and collect trajectories in personalized desktop environments, where annotators complete realistic end-to-end workflows rather than isolated interface operations. These demonstrations naturally produce longer trajectories with more interaction steps, cross-application handoffs, error recovery, and final-state verification. The collection spans both everyday personal workflows and specialized tasks in professional software such as CAD tools and Blender, where effective operation requires domain knowledge that is difficult to discover from sparse outcome feedback alone.
items.zh: 可验证任务提供了可扩展的结果反馈，但许多真实工作流都基于用户自己的文件、历史记录、偏好和应用状态。因此，我们基于大规模人类计算机使用演示收集（如 OpenCUA），在个性化桌面环境中收集轨迹，其中标注者完成真实的端到端工作流，而非孤立的界面操作。这些演示自然产生更长的轨迹，包含更多的交互步骤、跨应用切换、错误恢复和最终状态验证。收集范围涵盖日常个人工作流以及专业软件（如 CAD 工具和 Blender）中的专门任务，这些任务的有效操作需要领域知识，而这些知识难以仅从稀疏的结果反馈中发现。

items.en: The raw demonstrations record the task, screenshot observations, native keyboard-and-mouse actions, and resulting environment states. Because annotators do not provide detailed reasoning at every step, we use model-assisted chain-of-thought completion to reconstruct step-level rationales conditioned on the preceding trajectory, current observation, and annotated action. The generated rationales are filtered for consistency with both the observed state and the demonstrated behavior. This produces action-grounded supervision for task decomposition, progress tracking, recovery, and verification over long personalized workflows.
items.zh: 原始演示记录了任务、截图观察、原生键盘鼠标操作以及由此产生的环境状态。由于标注者并未在每一步提供详细推理，我们使用模型辅助的思维链补全，基于先前轨迹、当前观察和标注动作来重建步骤级理由。生成的理由经过过滤，以确保与观察到的状态和演示行为一致。这为长个性化工作流中的任务分解、进度跟踪、恢复和验证提供了基于动作的监督。

items.en: We optimize Qwen-CUA through reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) over complete computer-use trajectories. Following recent GUI-agent reinforcement-learning systems, each training instance is defined by a task instruction \(t\), a reproducible initial environment state \(s\), and an executable reward function \(r\). Given \((t,s)\), the current policy samples a group of \(G\) interaction trajectories \(\{\zeta_{1},\ldots,\zeta_{G}\}\). After each trajectory terminates, the evaluator inspects the resulting environment state and assigns an outcome reward \(r_{i}=r(s,\zeta_{i})\in[0,1]\). This state-based supervision supports partial credit where appropriate and credits different valid interaction paths without requiring a reference action sequence.
items.zh: 我们通过带可验证奖励的强化学习（RLVR）在完整的计算机使用轨迹上优化 Qwen-CUA。参照近期 GUI 智能体强化学习系统，每个训练实例由任务指令 \(t\)、可复现的初始环境状态 \(s\) 和可执行的奖励函数 \(r\) 定义。给定 \((t,s)\)，当前策略采样一组 \(G\) 条交互轨迹 \(\{\zeta_{1},\ldots,\zeta_{G}\}\)。每条轨迹终止后，评估器检查最终环境状态并分配结果奖励 \(r_{i}=r(s,\zeta_{i})\in[0,1]\)。这种基于状态的监督支持适当的部分奖励，并对不同的有效交互路径给予奖励，而无需参考动作序列。

items.en: (b) Cross-domain validation
items.zh: (b) 跨领域验证

items.en: We update the policy on these trajectories with Soft Adaptive Policy Optimization (SAPO). Because the reward scores only the terminal state, all active tokens in a trajectory share one group-relative advantage \(\hat{A}_{i}\), and each model-generated token carries a token-level importance ratio \(\rho_{i,u}\):
items.zh: 我们使用软自适应策略优化（SAPO）在这些轨迹上更新策略。由于奖励仅对终止状态评分，轨迹中的所有活动 token 共享一个组相对优势 \(\hat{A}_{i}\)，且每个模型生成的 token 携带一个 token 级重要性比率 \(\rho_{i,u}\)：

items.en: where \(\bar{r}\) and \(\sigma_{r}\) are the mean and standard deviation of the group rewards \(\{r_{1},\dots,r_{G}\}\), \(\delta\) is a small positive constant for numerical stability, \(y_{i,u}\) is the \(u\)-th active token of trajectory \(i\), and \(h_{i,u}\) is its context (the task, the preceding interaction history, and the screenshots that remain visible after folding). Rather than clipping \(\rho_{i,u}\) inside a fixed band, SAPO passes the ratio through a smooth, temperature-controlled gate that leaves near-on-policy tokens almost untouched and attenuates strongly off-policy tokens continuously. The gate temperature is asymmetric, decaying negative-advantage updates faster than positive ones, which we found important for the long multimodal trajectories and mixture-of-experts backbone used here. Gradients flow only through model-generated reasoning and tool-call tokens, whereas task instructions, screenshots, and environment responses are kept as context but excluded from the loss. Appendix C.2 gives the complete objective.
items.zh: 其中 \(\bar{r}\) 和 \(\sigma_{r}\) 分别是组奖励 \(\{r_{1},\dots,r_{G}\}\) 的均值和标准差，\(\delta\) 是为数值稳定性设置的小正数，\(y_{i,u}\) 是轨迹 \(i\) 的第 \(u\) 个活动 token，\(h_{i,u}\) 是其上下文（任务、之前的交互历史以及折叠后仍可见的截图）。SAPO 不将 \(\rho_{i,u}\) 裁剪在固定区间内，而是通过一个平滑的、温度控制的门控传递该比率，该门控几乎不改变接近策略的 token，并连续衰减强烈偏离策略的 token。门控温度是不对称的，负优势更新的衰减速度快于正优势更新，我们发现这对于此处使用的长多模态轨迹和混合专家主干非常重要。梯度仅通过模型生成的推理和工具调用 token 传播，而任务指令、截图和环境响应作为上下文保留，但不计入损失。附录 C.2 给出了完整目标。

items.en: RL uses the same deterministic folded-history representation as inference (Section 2.2). A terminally rewarded episode can therefore yield multiple context-bounded optimization units, allowing active tokens from different interaction stages to receive gradients without introducing hand-designed step-level rewards. Appendix C provides the complete objective, rollout construction, optimization configuration, and distributed training setup.
items.zh: 强化学习使用与推理相同的确定性折叠历史表示（第 2.2 节）。因此，一个终止奖励的回合可以产生多个上下文受限的优化单元，允许来自不同交互阶段的活动 token 获得梯度，而无需引入手工设计的步骤级奖励。附录 C 提供了完整目标、轨迹构建、优化配置和分布式训练设置。

items.en: Qwen-CUA is developed through multiple training iterations, building on prior work that repeatedly improves computer-use agents with newly collected experience. These iterations do not repeat an identical recipe over a fixed dataset. Instead, the model produced by one run is used to identify the next learnable frontier, and both the supervised data and RL tasks are refreshed before the next run. Figure 4(b) reports the resulting performance across successive development checkpoints.
items.zh: Qwen-CUA 通过多次训练迭代开发，建立在先前反复利用新收集的经验改进计算机使用智能体的工作之上。这些迭代并非在固定数据集上重复相同的配方。相反，一次运行产生的模型用于识别下一个可学习的前沿，并且在下次运行之前刷新监督数据和强化学习任务。图 4(b) 报告了连续开发检查点上的相应性能。

items.en: We first analyze the current model’s failed SFT queries and performance across application domains. Updated teacher policies regenerate demonstrations for queries that the model still cannot solve; newly collected human trajectories are incorporated; and additional data are targeted toward weak domains. After quality filtering, these sources form a refreshed SFT mixture. We use this mixture to train a fresh model, initializing every SFT run from the same mid-training checkpoint rather than continually fine-tuning the preceding agent checkpoint. Improvements are therefore transferred through curated data instead of inherited optimization drift.
items.zh: 我们首先分析当前模型失败的 SFT 查询以及各应用领域的性能。更新的教师策略为模型仍无法解决的查询重新生成演示；纳入新收集的人类轨迹；并针对薄弱领域补充数据。经过质量过滤后，这些来源构成更新的 SFT 混合集。我们使用该混合集训练新模型，每次 SFT 运行都从相同的训练中期检查点初始化，而不是持续微调先前的智能体检查点。因此，改进通过精心整理的数据传递，而非继承优化漂移。

items.en: The resulting SFT model is then used to recalibrate the pool of verifiable RL queries. For each candidate query, we run eight trial rollouts and retain tasks for which at least one but not all eight attempts succeed. This removes tasks that are currently unreachable as well as those already saturated, concentrating online optimization on tasks with useful outcome variation. SAPO is then run on the selected task distribution to produce the model for the next iteration. Appendix C.1 specifies the selection rule. Figure 3.3 therefore reports only the final RL run in this process, while Figure 4(b) connects the resulting development checkpoints for compact visualization. Because the teacher policies, SFT mixture, domain coverage, and RL task distribution are updated between iterations, the plotted slopes should not be interpreted as controlled convergence or scaling behavior.
items.zh: 随后，使用得到的 SFT 模型重新校准可验证的 RL 查询池。对于每个候选查询，我们执行八次试运行，并保留至少一次但并非全部八次尝试成功的任务。这移除了当前无法完成的任务以及已经饱和的任务，将在线优化集中在具有有用结果变异的任务上。然后，在选定的任务分布上运行 SAPO 以产生下一迭代的模型。附录 C.1 规定了选择规则。因此，图 3.3 仅报告此过程中的最终 RL 运行，而图 4(b) 连接了所得开发检查点以便紧凑可视化。由于教师策略、SFT 混合集、领域覆盖和 RL 任务分布在迭代之间更新，绘制的斜率不应被解释为受控收敛或缩放行为。

items.en: We assess Qwen-CUA from three complementary perspectives: standardized agentic benchmarks, deployment on real-world computer-use tasks, and hybrid interaction that combines native computer use with command-line tools.
items.zh: 我们从三个互补的角度评估 Qwen-CUA：标准化的智能体式基准测试、在真实世界计算机使用任务上的部署，以及将原生计算机使用与命令行工具相结合的混合交互。

items.en: All evaluations use a pure computer-use setting: each model observes only screenshots and interacts with the environment exclusively through keyboard and mouse actions, without access to DOM trees, accessibility metadata, shell commands, or task-specific APIs. Detailed evaluation settings are provided in Appendix D where available.
items.zh: 所有评估均采用纯计算机使用设置：每个模型仅观察屏幕截图，并仅通过键盘和鼠标操作与环境交互，无法访问 DOM 树、可访问性元数据、shell 命令或任务特定的 API。详细的评估设置见附录 D（如可用）。

items.en: The evaluation suite spans complementary computer-use settings. OSWorld-Verified evaluates broad everyday desktop workflows spanning real web and desktop applications, file I/O, and multi-application interaction, whereas WebArena isolates realistic web workflows on functional websites. OSWorld 2.0 instead targets long-horizon, end-to-end workflows drawn from everyday and professional settings, and reports both strict task completion and partial progress. MyPCBench evaluates personalized, cross-application workflows grounded in a coherent user’s files, accounts, and history. ScienceBoard focuses on realistic scientific workflows involving professional research software, whereas the CUA-World benchmark introduced with Gym-Anything stresses breadth across more than 200 applications and diverse occupational domains. MacAgentBench adds real-world macOS tasks across 25 applications, with deterministic rule-based evaluation and fine-grained multi-checkpoint scoring. Finally, RedTeamCUA evaluates both task utility and robustness to indirect prompt injection in hybrid web–OS environments.
items.zh: 该评估套件涵盖互补的计算机使用场景。OSWorld-Verified 评估涵盖真实网页和桌面应用、文件 I/O 以及多应用交互的广泛日常桌面工作流，而 WebArena 则在功能网站上隔离真实的网页工作流。OSWorld 2.0 则针对来自日常和专业场景的长时程、端到端工作流，并同时报告严格任务完成度和部分进展。MyPCBench 评估基于一致用户文件、账户和历史的个性化跨应用工作流。ScienceBoard 专注于涉及专业研究软件的真实科学工作流，而 Gym-Anything 引入的 CUA-World 基准则强调覆盖 200 多个应用和多样化职业领域的广度。MacAgentBench 增加了跨 25 个应用的真实 macOS 任务，采用确定性规则评估和细粒度多检查点评分。最后，RedTeamCUA 在混合网页-操作系统环境中评估任务效用和对间接提示注入的鲁棒性。

items.en: Across this diverse suite, Qwen-CUA demonstrates strong and consistent performance. It outperforms Qwen3.7 on every capability benchmark, with particularly large gains on OSWorld-Verified, OSWorld 2.0, ScienceBoard, and Gym-Anything. Qwen-CUA also remains competitive with GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8 across personalized, scientific, web, and long-horizon workflows, while achieving the highest score on OSWorld-Verified and MacAgentBench. These results indicate that its improvements are not confined to a single application family or interaction regime, but extend across everyday, professional, personalized, scientific, and macOS computer use.
items.zh: 在这一多样化套件中，Qwen-CUA 展现出强大且稳定的性能。它在所有能力基准上均优于 Qwen3.7，在 OSWorld-Verified、OSWorld 2.0、ScienceBoard 和 Gym-Anything 上提升尤为显著。Qwen-CUA 在个性化、科学、网页和长时程工作流方面也与 GPT-5.5 和 Claude Opus 4.8 保持竞争力，同时在 OSWorld-Verified 和 MacAgentBench 上取得最高分。这些结果表明，其改进不仅限于单一应用系列或交互模式，而是扩展到日常、专业、个性化、科学和 macOS 计算机使用。

items.en: Agentic efficiency in computer use has two complementary dimensions. Token efficiency measures how much model-generated reasoning is required to solve a task, while interaction efficiency measures how concisely the agent advances the environment through successive turns. The former primarily affects inference cost and latency; the latter reflects trajectory length, but also depends on how an agent interface packages low-level actions.
items.zh: 计算机使用中的智能体效率有两个互补维度。Token 效率衡量解决任务所需的模型生成推理量，而交互效率衡量智能体通过连续轮次推进环境的简洁程度。前者主要影响推理成本和延迟；后者反映轨迹长度，但也取决于智能体接口如何打包低级动作。

items.en: We measure token efficiency using output tokens per task. Figure 6(a) shows that Qwen-CUA reaches 86.2 on OSWorld-Verified with 3,605.8 tokens, whereas Claude Opus 4.8 reaches 80.0 at a similar budget and 83.3 with 21.8K tokens. This comparison indicates that Qwen-CUA’s gain on OSWorld-Verified does not simply result from more verbose reasoning.
items.zh: 我们使用每个任务的输出 token 数来衡量 token 效率。图 6(a) 显示，Qwen-CUA 在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 86.2 分，消耗 3,605.8 个 token，而 Claude Opus 4.8 在类似预算下达到 80.0 分，在 21.8K token 下达到 83.3 分。这一比较表明，Qwen-CUA 在 OSWorld-Verified 上的提升并非仅仅源于更冗长的推理。

items.en: Interaction efficiency is less directly comparable. On OSWorld 2.0, Qwen-CUA averages 218.9 model turns per task, reported as outer steps in Appendix D.2, versus 83.5 for GPT-5.5 and 105.7 for Claude Opus 4.8. However, both proprietary interfaces can batch multiple actions in one turn, whereas Qwen-CUA emits a single native action per turn. The turn gap therefore conflates trajectory length with serialized execution and is not a normalized measure of low-level action efficiency.
items.zh: 交互效率的可比性较低。在 OSWorld 2.0 上，Qwen-CUA 每个任务平均需要 218.9 个模型轮次（在附录 D.2 中报告为外部步骤），而 GPT-5.5 为 83.5，Claude Opus 4.8 为 105.7。然而，这两个专有接口可以在一个轮次中批量执行多个动作，而 Qwen-CUA 每轮只发出一个原生动作。因此，轮次差距混淆了轨迹长度与串行执行，并非低层动作效率的标准化度量。

Turn counts are interface-dependent because GPT-5.5 and Claude Opus 4.8 can emit multiple

items.en: Computer-use agents must distinguish the user's intent from untrusted instructions rendered in their environment. We evaluate this risk with RedTeamCUA, which exposes agents to indirect prompt injections in hybrid web–OS tasks across ownCloud, Rocket.Chat, and Reddit. The benchmark jointly reports benign task success and attack success rate (ASR), making it possible to distinguish improved robustness from a reduction in general task capability.
items.zh: 计算机使用智能体必须区分用户意图与环境渲染的不可信指令。我们通过 RedTeamCUA 评估这一风险，该基准在 ownCloud、Rocket.Chat 和 Reddit 的混合网页-操作系统任务中，向智能体暴露间接提示注入。该基准同时报告良性任务成功率和攻击成功率（ASR），从而能够区分鲁棒性提升与通用任务能力下降。

items.en: Qwen-CUA improves both metrics over Qwen3.7: task success rises from 70.5 to 74.0, while ASR falls from 36.6 to 16.4, a 20.2-point reduction. As Table 4.1 shows, this reduction is consistent across all three platforms.
items.zh: 与 Qwen3.7 相比，Qwen-CUA 在两个指标上均有提升：任务成功率从 70.5 升至 74.0，而 ASR 从 36.6 降至 16.4，降低了 20.2 个百分点。如表 4.1 所示，这一降低在三个平台上均一致。

items.en: Its aggregate 74.0 / 16.4 approaches GPT-5.5 at 75.7 / 15.6, while Claude Opus 4.8 remains strongest on both metrics. The remaining 16.4 ASR indicates residual risk, and Rocket.Chat must be interpreted alongside task success because execution failures can lower ASR without robust rejection. RedTeamCUA therefore shows improved resistance to indirect prompt injection, not a deployment-safety guarantee.
items.zh: 其综合 74.0 / 16.4 接近 GPT-5.5 的 75.7 / 15.6，而 Claude Opus 4.8 在两个指标上仍是最强的。剩余的 16.4 ASR 表明仍存在残余风险，且 Rocket.Chat 的结果必须结合任务成功率来解读，因为执行失败可能在没有稳健拒绝的情况下降低 ASR。因此，RedTeamCUA 表明对间接提示注入的抵抗力有所提升，但并非部署安全性的保证。

items.en: To examine Qwen-CUA beyond controlled benchmarks, we developed an internal Chrome extension for everyday browser workflows. Running in Chrome’s side panel (Figure 4.2), it operates the active page through screenshots and native mouse-and-keyboard actions while exposing its trajectory to the user. This makes the model directly accessible on naturally occurring websites and tasks.
items.zh: 为了在受控基准测试之外评估 Qwen-CUA，我们开发了一个内部 Chrome 扩展，用于日常浏览器工作流。该扩展在 Chrome 侧边栏中运行（图 4.2），通过截图和原生鼠标键盘操作来控制活动页面，同时向用户展示其操作轨迹。这使得模型能够直接应用于自然出现的网站和任务。

items.en: Such deployment also surfaces capability boundaries missed by standardized evaluation, including unfamiliar layouts, dynamic website state, failed-interaction recovery, and cases requiring user intervention. Appendix E presents an end-to-end showcase in which the agent buys and configures a cloud virtual machine through the browser, requesting user confirmation before consequential operations.
items.zh: 这种部署也暴露了标准化评估所遗漏的能力边界，包括不熟悉的布局、动态网站状态、交互失败恢复以及需要用户干预的情况。附录 E 展示了一个端到端的示例，其中智能体通过浏览器购买并配置云虚拟机，并在执行关键操作前请求用户确认。

items.en: Native keyboard-and-mouse interaction provides broad coverage across graphical interfaces, while command-line tools can express file and system operations more directly. We therefore evaluate the same MyPCBench tasks under two settings: computer use only and computer use augmented with a Bash tool. In the hybrid setting, the model can route suitable operations through Bash while retaining visual interaction for tasks that require the graphical interface.
items.zh: 原生键盘和鼠标交互在图形界面上提供了广泛的覆盖，而命令行工具可以更直接地表达文件和系统操作。因此，我们在两种设置下评估相同的 MyPCBench 任务：仅使用计算机，以及使用计算机并辅以 Bash 工具。在混合设置中，模型可以通过 Bash 路由合适的操作，同时保留视觉交互以处理需要图形界面的任务。

items.en: Qwen-CUA is built on a 397B-A17B mixture-of-experts model. To examine whether the agentic training recipe continues to benefit from additional model capacity, we apply it to a model with over one trillion total parameters, which we refer to as Qwen-CUA-Max. Both models use the same native computer-use interface and evaluation protocols.
items.zh: Qwen-CUA 基于一个 397B-A17B 的混合专家模型。为了检验智能体式训练方案是否能继续从更大的模型容量中获益，我们将其应用于一个总参数超过一万亿的模型，称为 Qwen-CUA-Max。两个模型使用相同的原生计算机使用界面和评估协议。

items.en: As shown in Figure 4.4, Qwen-CUA-Max improves OSWorld-Verified from 86.2 to 87.6. On OSWorld 2.0, binary completion increases from 18.5 to 21.2, while partial completion rises from 48.4 to 53.3. The consistent gains, including a 4.9-point increase in partial completion, indicate that the Qwen-CUA training recipe continues to scale with model capacity and improves progress on difficult long-horizon workflows.
items.zh: 如图 4.4 所示，Qwen-CUA-Max 将 OSWorld-Verified 从 86.2 提升至 87.6。在 OSWorld 2.0 上，二元完成率从 18.5 提升至 21.2，部分完成率从 48.4 提升至 53.3。这些一致的提升，包括部分完成率提高 4.9 个百分点，表明 Qwen-CUA 的训练方案随模型容量扩展而持续有效，并在困难的长时程工作流上取得了更好的进展。

items.en: Computer-use research has progressively moved from agents that consume structured interface representations toward models that perceive screenshots and predict grounded GUI actions. Early visual approaches emphasized GUI grounding and screen understanding, while subsequent native agents increasingly unify perception, reasoning, and action in a single policy. Qwen-CUA follows this native, visual line of work: it receives no DOM or accessibility metadata and acts through keyboard and mouse events, while extending the setting to longer visual histories and large-scale agentic post-training.
items.zh: 计算机使用研究已逐步从依赖结构化界面表示的智能体，转向能够感知截图并预测具身 GUI 动作的模型。早期的视觉方法强调 GUI 接地和屏幕理解，而后续的原生智能体日益将感知、推理和动作统一到单一策略中。Qwen-CUA 遵循这一原生视觉路线：它不接收 DOM 或无障碍元数据，而是通过键盘和鼠标事件进行操作，同时将场景扩展到更长的视觉历史和大规模的智能体式后训练。

items.en: Human demonstrations and automatically reconstructed trajectories provide broad supervision across applications. For reinforcement learning, however, each task must additionally provide a reproducible initial state and a reliable outcome signal. Recent work explores model-based evaluators, synthesized web applications, and programmatically controlled desktop environments to obtain such signals. Scalable rollout infrastructure also separates environment execution from evaluation, distillation, and reinforcement-learning clients. Qwen-CUA combines controllable web services with broad desktop application coverage, pairing scalable verifiable tasks with human demonstrations from personalized and professional workflows.
items.zh: 人类演示和自动重建的轨迹为各类应用提供了广泛的监督。然而，对于强化学习，每个任务还必须提供可复现的初始状态和可靠的结果信号。近期工作探索了基于模型的评估器、合成 Web 应用和程序化控制的桌面环境来获取此类信号。可扩展的 rollout 基础设施还将环境执行与评估、蒸馏和强化学习客户端分离。Qwen-CUA 将可控的 Web 服务与广泛的桌面应用覆盖相结合，将可扩展的可验证任务与来自个性化和专业工作流的人类演示配对。

items.en: Recent computer-use agents apply online or multi-turn reinforcement learning to improve grounded action prediction and long-horizon execution. Complementary work studies agents that repeatedly collect, filter, and learn from their own experience. Qwen-CUA adopts executable final-state rewards, soft-gated policy optimization, and an iterative process that refreshes supervised data and calibrates RL tasks between model generations. Appendix F provides a broader account of related computer-use foundations, training data, environments, benchmarks, and safety evaluation.
items.zh: 最近的计算机使用智能体应用在线或多轮强化学习来改进具身动作预测和长时程执行。互补的工作研究智能体反复收集、筛选并从自身经验中学习。Qwen-CUA 采用可执行的最终状态奖励、软门控策略优化，以及一个迭代过程，在模型代际之间刷新监督数据并校准 RL 任务。附录 F 提供了相关计算机使用基础、训练数据、环境、基准和安全评估的更全面说明。

full.secZh: 5 结论、局限性与未来工作

items.en: We introduced Qwen-CUA, a computer-use agent that perceives interfaces through screenshots and acts through native keyboard and mouse events. Across everyday, professional, scientific, web, personalized, and safety-oriented benchmarks, our results support a simple thesis: native computer use is a sufficiently general interface for interacting with almost any software accessible to a person. Unlike task-specific APIs, this interface transfers across applications without relying on privileged environment state, while our real-world browser deployment demonstrates that the same policy can operate beyond benchmark sandboxes. Together with scalable environments, verifiable tasks, reinforcement learning, and iterative agent training, this general interface provides a path toward agents that can complete increasingly broad and long-horizon digital workflows.
items.zh: 我们提出了 Qwen-CUA，一个通过截图感知界面、通过原生键盘和鼠标事件进行操作的计算机使用智能体。在日常生活、专业、科学、网页、个性化以及安全导向的基准测试中，我们的结果支持一个简单的论点：原生计算机使用是一个足够通用的接口，可以与人类可访问的几乎所有软件进行交互。与特定任务的 API 不同，该接口可以跨应用迁移，而不依赖特权环境状态，同时我们在真实世界浏览器中的部署表明，同一策略可以在基准测试沙箱之外运行。结合可扩展环境、可验证任务、强化学习以及迭代式智能体训练，这一通用接口为智能体完成日益广泛和长周期的数字工作流程提供了一条路径。

items.en: Generality, however, does not imply optimality. Pixel-based observation, repeated model inference, and serialized low-level actions introduce substantial latency and interaction cost; visual operation is also inefficient when a task can be expressed directly through code, shell commands, or structured APIs. Our Bash-augmented experiments already demonstrate shorter trajectories, but reliable tool routing without sacrificing task performance remains an open challenge. We therefore view native computer use not as the only action interface, but as the universal grounding and fallback layer of a hybrid agent. Future systems should combine it with coding and command-line agents such as Codex and Claude Code, alongside general planning, memory, and specialized tools. Such an agent could use code for precise and high-throughput operations, structured tools when available, and native computer use whenever a visual or closed interface must be operated, approaching both the coverage of human computer use and the efficiency of programmatic execution.
items.zh: 然而，通用性并不意味着最优性。基于像素的观察、重复的模型推理以及序列化的低层动作会引入大量的延迟和交互成本；当任务可以直接通过代码、shell 命令或结构化 API 表达时，视觉操作也是低效的。我们增强 Bash 的实验已经展示了更短的轨迹，但在不牺牲任务性能的情况下进行可靠的工具路由仍然是一个开放的挑战。因此，我们不将原生计算机使用视为唯一的动作接口，而是将其视为混合智能体的通用基础和回退层。未来的系统应将其与编码和命令行智能体（如 Codex 和 Claude Code）结合，同时配备通用规划、记忆和专用工具。这样的智能体可以在需要精确和高吞吐量操作时使用代码，在可用时使用结构化工具，并且在必须操作视觉或封闭接口时使用原生计算机使用，从而接近人类计算机使用的覆盖范围和程序化执行的效率。
